title: No More Import Errors: Constrained Decoding for Guaranteed Valid Imports in LLM-Generated Tests
abstract: arXiv:2610.41878v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: One of the most common failure reasons of LLM-based test generation pipelines is import errors. Grammar constrained decoding can modify the probabilities of the LLM's final layer during token generation to guarantee valid imports. However, we find that it can lead to degenerate solutions, i.e., repetitive valid imports (import streaks) that exhaust the token budget before a test is generated. We propose Constrained Beam Decoding with Lookup (CBDL), a novel method that guarantees import validity while addressing import streaks by avoiding premature commitment to tokens that lead to repetitive imports. Because it operates at the decoding stage, CBDL can be integrated into existing LLM-based test generation pipelines.   We implement CBDL for Python and Java and evaluate it on two test generation tasks, showing that generated tests have 100% valid imports, outperforming both static (RAG and LIBRO) and dynamic (Agentic Repair) import-validity

translated_title: 告别导入错误：约束解码确保LLM生成测试中的有效导入
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的测试生成流水线最常见的失败原因之一是导入错误。语法约束解码可以在token生成过程中修改LLM最后一层的概率，以保证导入的有效性。然而，我们发现这种方法可能导致退化解，即重复的有效导入（导入串流），在生成测试之前就耗尽了token预算。我们提出了带查找的约束束解码（Constrained Beam Decoding with Lookup，CBDL），这是一种新方法，在保证导入有效性的同时，通过避免过早提交会导致重复导入的token来解决导入串流问题。由于CBDL在解码阶段运行，因此可以集成到现有的基于LLM的测试生成流水线中。我们为Python和Java实现了CBDL，并在两个测试生成任务上进行了评估，结果表明生成的测试具有100%的有效导入，优于静态方法（RAG和LIBRO）以及动态方法（Agentic Repair）的导入有效性表现。
tldr: 提出带查找的约束束解码（CBDL）方法，在解码阶段通过避免过早提交导致重复导入的token，既保证了LLM生成测试的导入100%有效，又解决了导入串流耗尽token预算的问题，且可无缝集成到现有测试生成流水线中。
